name: anandvaidya-portfolio
description: Static portfolio for anandvaidya.in. Edit src/, then run `npm run build` to regenerate the minified assets in the site root.

scripts.build:js: terser src/script.js --compress --mangle --comments false -o script.min.js && terser src/eggs.js --compress --mangle --comments false -o eggs.min.js && terser src/case.js --compress --mangle --comments false -o case.min.js
scripts.build:css: csso src/styles.css -o styles.min.css && csso src/eggs.css -o eggs.min.css && csso src/case.css -o case.min.css
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
